home.heroSubtitle: A gentle guide from names to care
home.heroDescription: Succulents get their name from their thick, juicy leaves. Drought-tolerant, easy-going and endlessly varied, they make perfect companions. Here you'll find scientific names, growing environments, growth cycles and care tips — plus your own personal succulent diary.
home.featurePlantsDesc: Scientific names, common names, environment, growth cycle and care tips.
home.featureDiaryDesc: Upload photos, record growth and mood, and watch them grow together.
home.featureLangDesc: Built for Chinese users, switchable to English in one click.

about.title: About
about.intro: Succulent Guide is a reference and journaling site for succulent lovers. Plant information is curated by hand, and all photos are real photography from Wikimedia Commons — never AI-generated.
about.imageSourceDesc: All plant photos come from Wikimedia Commons under their respective free licenses (CC BY-SA, CC BY, or public domain). Full source, author and license info is in IMAGE_SOURCES.md.
about.dataDesc: Scientific names use international Latin naming; common names follow common horticultural usage. Care advice is general — always adjust to your local climate and the plant's condition.

footer.tagline: Growing slowly, together with your succulents
